mapper.sql: d.id, d.title, d.subject_word, d.send_to_dept, d.copy_to_dept, d.urgency, d.security_level, d.content, d.status, d.emp_id, d.dept_id, d.wf_instance_id, d.create_time, d.update_time, e.real_name AS emp_name, dp.dept_name
FROM doc_dispatches d LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON d.emp_id = e.id AND e.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept dp ON d.dept_id = dp.id AND dp.del_flag = '0' WHERE d.del_flag = '0'
